primaryChecks.text: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

context.text: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

primaryChecks.text: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.

context.text: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

primaryChecks.text: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;

context.text: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.

primaryChecks.text: When we cried to the LORD, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

context.text: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.

“Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

primaryChecks.text: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

context.text: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

primaryChecks.text: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

context.text: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;
Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

primaryChecks.text: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

context.text: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
